To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the completion of design in use is the result of users’ appropriation activities, that users’ appropriation activities are a crucial part of the design of a technology innovations, that the design of technology innovations is completed in use, that the completion of the design in use process results in a new design of the technology innovation, and that the new design is the result of the users’ appropriation of the technology innovation.

(1) the design of a technology is not completed until users have appropriated it; (2) users’ appropriation of a technology is an essential design activity; (3) users’ appropriation is an important source of information about the design of a new technology; (4) designers need to design for appropriation, and (5) users need to be supported and encouraged to appropriate new technologies.
the design of a technology is completed by users in the course of appropriating the technology and that the design and implementation processes should be aligned to support this completion process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the completion of design in use.
the completion of design in use.
the completion of the design process through appropriation and the implications for the development of technology innovations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the appropriation of an innovation by users is a crucial part of its design.
the appropriation of a technology innovation completes its design.
the design of technology innovations is not complete until users have appropriated the innovation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been able to show that the design of a technology is completed in use and that this completion is a crucial part of a technology innovation’s success or failure.
we have developed a model for design in use that is based on the appropriation cycle.
design in use is a crucial aspect of the technology design process and the appropriation cycle.
The main takeaway from our work is that
designers need to consider users’ appropriation activities in their design processes and managers need to support users’ appropriation of new innovations.
users’ appropriation of a technology innovation completes the innovation’s design and, therefore, is an essential part of its implementation.
the design and implementation process should be seen as an iterative, ongoing process of co-evolution between users and technology.
